responsibility: Provides shared utilities for nice region diagnostics to map anonymous regions back to function parameters or return types, reconstruct substituted parameter types, and detect special cases such as `self` parameters.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `traits/util.rs`, which serves trait solving and obligation elaboration, this `util.rs` is narrowly for lifetime diagnostics inside nice region errors. Its code maps anonymous regions back to concrete function parameters or return positions, reconstructs substituted parameter types, and detects `self`-parameter cases for region-error reporting.
